component.name: Fuzzy Buddy Farms
component.summary: Build a bee farm in the town of Honeyville

description.p: Welcome to Honeyville! Build and grow your own bee farm from a small starting plot of land. Purchase hives, flowers, trees, and queen bee upgrades at the market.

Strategize your business model — each NPC buys honey at a different rate. Seasons, weather cycles, and day/night cycles all affect honey production and value. Visit the soccer field, race track, fishing pond, and park for mini games.
Everything is rendered with vector math in Raylib, so it runs on almost any hardware from the past two decades.

screenshot.caption: Your farm in Honeyville on a summer morning
